SPECIFICATION FOR 

SQUARE DRIVE EXTENSION FOR HEXAGON 

INSERT BITS FOR POWER SOCKET WRENCHES 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and other requirements for square drive extension for hexagon 
insert bits for power socket wrenches. These are also commonly known as adaptors. 

2. Dimensions ~ Shall be as given below. 



DRIV ING SQUARE 
.is: 7996 




HE_XAGON EMD 
TYPE A, IS:8669 



CRIVING SQUARE HE_XAGON END 

;:7996 \TYPE E, IS;8669

Note — The figures given above are only for illustrations. 

•Male driving squares shall conform to IS : 7996-1976 'Specification for driving squares for power socket 
wrenches'. Choice of Type E or Type F shall be as agreed to by the manufacturer. 

tMale hexagon ends shall conform to 18:8669-1977 'Dimensions for hexagon drive ends for power 
tools'. 

- 



3. Material — Suitable steels meeting the requirements laid down in 4. Some of tlie suitable steels 
are: 

Steel designation T50 Cr4 V2 with sulphur and phosphorus contents of 005 percent each 
specified in IS : 3749-1978 'Specification for tool and die steels for cold work {first revision)' . or steel 
designation 55 C4 conforming to IS : 1570 ( Part 2 )-1979 'Schedules for wrought steel : Part 2 
Carbon steels ( unalloyed steels ) ( first revision )'.

18:12470-1988 

4. Hardness — 52 HRC, Min. 

5. Designation — An adaptor with male driving square 16, male hexagon, Type E nominal size 11 '2, 
and of length = 70 mm, conforming to this specification shall be designated as: 

Adaptor 16 x E 11*2 x 70 IS : 12470. 

6. Workmanship and Finish 

6.1 Adaptors shall be free from burrs, scales, cracks and other manufacturing surface defects. Edges 
shall be chamfered. 

6.2 The adaptors may be blank, burnished or electroplated. The surface finish shall be as agreed to 
between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 

7. IVIarkIng — Adaptors shall be marked with the nominal dimensions of male driving square and 
male hexagon towards their respective ends, and manufacturer's name, initials or registered trade-mark. 

7.1 Standard Mark — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

8. Sampling 

8.1 Lot — All the hexagonal insert bits of the same dimension, manufactured from the same material 
under similar conditions of production shall be grouped together to constitute a lot. 

8.2 In order to ascertain the conformity of the lot, the procedure for sampling inspection as given in 
IS : 2500 (Part 1 )-1 973 'Sampling inspection tables : Part 1 Inspection by attributes and by count 
of defects (//r5frew5/a/7)', shall be followed. For various characteristics, the sampling procedure as 
given in 8,2,1 and 8.2.2 shall be followed. 

8.2.1 For dimensions and workmanship and finish, the single sampling pfan with inspection level 
IV and acceptable quality level ( AQL) of 2'5 percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )- 
1973 shall be followed. 

8.2.2 For hardness, the single sampling plan with inspection level II and acceptable quality level 
(AQL) of 25 percent as given in Tables 1 and 2 of IS : 2500 (Part 1 )-1973 shall be followed. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

While formulating this standard, assistance has been derived from D!N 7428-1382 'Square drive 
extension hexagon inserts for power socket wrenches', issued by the Deutsches Institut fur Normung 
(DIN), 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi , India
